comments.text: CSE499A (RTk) - This course can be a life-changing course if you enroll under a faculty member who will guide you in building an excellent project that will both elevate your technical skills and your CV. And, if the faculty pushes you for a publication in a reputed Q1 journal, that's a huge plus point. RTk is one such faculty. Not only does he guide you in choosing an elegant project, but he will be there throughout the entire journey: building the project to writing the research paper, to publishing the paper in a reputed Journal or Conference. When I took this course under him in 2024, all the groups in our section had published a paper based on their CSE499 project. Our paper was published in the Q1 Journal Plos Computational Biology. He is very friendly, supportive, and approachable. However, one thing about him is particularly dangerous: he is very strict with deadlines, meeting his standards, and adhering to academic integrity, including avoiding plagiarism. He will share this detail in the first class. If you fail to give regular, meaningful updates in every class, or fail to meet his deadlines, or plagiarise, he will heavily penalize your marks. He is extremely picky in giving A's. Although this is a group project, your grade depends on your own effort, not that of your group members (every member might get a different grade based on their efforts and contributions). He failed 5-6 students from our CSE499A section and also gave very low grades (D) to some students in CSE499B. So be very careful about that. If you remain consistent on a regular basis and put on honest efforts, you don't need to worry about your grade. You have made a good choice.
